identity.name: Automatic Extra Flat
identity.one_liner: The 38.7mm extra-flat Richard Mille — the brand's most wearable entry, designed with sprinter Wayde van Niekerk. Carbon-TPT case, 7.8mm thin, the RM that does not look like an RM.

provenance_events.description: Richard Mille releases the 32-gram RM 67-02 sports watch with the automatic CRMA7 calibre.

narrative.story: The RM 67-02 is the most restrained Richard Mille in production. The 38.7mm tonneau case is 7.8mm thin — the thinnest RM ever. The CRMA7 caliber is a skeletonized micro-rotor automatic with a 50-hour reserve. The "Extra Flat" name is misleading; the watch is only extra flat by Richard Mille standards (most RM cases are 12-16mm thick). The RM 67-02 was the watch worn by sprinter Wayde van Niekerk in his post-injury comeback and the watch worn on the wrist of actress Margot Robbie in Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. The RM 67-02 is the most-cited "wearable" Richard Mille and the only one a normal human can fit under a shirt cuff.
